hypothesis: SCCs in the implication graph of genuine original two-literal clauses may prove variable equivalences x<=>y or x<=>not(y). Canonicalizing clause literals under these proven equivalences may expose complete XOR sign-mask blocks not syntactically present in source; any derived parity equation is an ADDITIONAL consequence, NOT a replacement for any original clause.

pre_registered_safety.binary_graph_edges: For every original 2-literal non-tautological clause (a OR b), add literal implications not(a)=>b and not(b)=>a, with original clause index.
pre_registered_safety.equivalence_proof: Only SCC mutual-reachability allows replacement v by signed representative; source binary-clause index witness paths must be independently rechecked for every nontrivial substituted literal used in derived parity claims.
pre_registered_safety.new_parity_certificate: Full 2^(k-1) sign-mask class of canonicalized clauses, width 1-6; original source indices of every claimed mask, plus mutually reachable witness paths.
pre_registered_safety.solution_safety: Do not replace original CNF in any production computation. Derived XOR may be ADDED only as a theorem implied by all original clauses. No SAT or UNSAT solver runs in stage 004D5.
pre_registered_safety.contradiction_handling: If binary implication graph has v and neg v in same SCC, ABSTAIN_SOURCE_BINARY_CONTRADICTION pending independent original clause proof; do not silently report UNSAT.
pre_registered_safety.failure_reporting: No binary equivalences, no newly implied XOR, overbudget, timeout or contradictions all retained as negative or abstain. Never infer general speedup, P=NP or time/chaos physics from an encoding.
